india.one_line: MeitY questioned home services platforms over in-home video data collection, while NITI Aayog warned against power concentration, and Norwest closed a $4 billion fund for AI startups.

themes.title: MeitY questions platforms over video data
themes.text: MeitY held a consultation with home services platforms and robotics companies regarding the collection of in-home video footage by gig workers for physical AI model training, questioning them on consent, privacy, and data-sharing contracts.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI

themes.title: NITI Aayog warns of power concentration
themes.text: NITI Aayog distinguished fellow Debjani Ghosh warned that capital concentration and circular financing among few companies pose systemic risks and weaken competition.

stories.headline: Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warns AI risk lies in capital and power concentration

themes.title: Norwest closes $4 billion AI fund
themes.text: Norwest closed an $18th fund totaling $4 billion to invest in early-stage and growth ventures across India, the US, and Israel, focusing on sectors including physical AI and voice AI.

stories.headline: Norwest closes $4 billion fund to back AI startups in US, India and Israel
